messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High latency on generation.redwoodapi.com — P95 jumped from ~1.2s to ~4.8s across us-west-2. Streaming session queue depth high. Severity: SEV2. Pager dispatched.

sre_oncall_anna: ack. I'm on it, starting initial triage. Posting what I'm seeing in Grafana.

alex_k: seeing the same. GPU queue depth at ~95% and long-lived streaming sessions are the outlier. Throughput per-GPU has dropped.

maya_ops: any deploys in the last hour?

infra_julian: no deploys. Autoscaler hasn't created new inference nodes — scaling decision seems stalled. Investigating why.

sre_oncall_anna: hypothesis: streaming + long-lived connections preventing efficient batching and keeping KV caches warm with lots of small writes. Quick mitigation candidate: temporarily disable streaming responses on the generation route to reduce active connections and restore throughput.

csm_jordan: note — several enterprise customers rely on streaming for transcripts. We'll need to notify them if we flip this.

product-liz: temporary disable is ok for a short window if it stabilizes production. Keep me in the loop on UX impact.

sre_oncall_anna: plan: apply a 10% canary where route-level "streaming_enabled": false. Observe metrics 90–120s. If P95 improves and no major side-effects, ramp to 100%.

sre_oncall_anna: ```bash
# toggle route config via control plane API (internal)
curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood.internal/api/routes/patch \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"route":"generation","overrides":{"streaming_enabled":false},"pct":10}'
```

alex_k: canary applied. Metrics updating — p95 down to ~800ms on the canary slice within 60–90s. Active_stream_sessions on canary dropped ~70%.

incident-bot: Action logged: canary applied to 10% at 1718001290.

maya_ops: request: also throttle new streaming session creation to avoid refill — set per-tenant stream_sessions_per_min to 2 globally as a temporary safety net.

maya_ops: ```json
{"command":"set_quota","scope":"global","stream_sessions_per_min":2}
```

ops_ben: applied global quota change.

sre_oncall_anna: continue monitoring. If canary remains stable for 2 more minutes I'll roll to 100% and post updates.

alex_k: queue depth on main pool is already starting to drain. GPU utilization more even.

sre_oncall_anna: rolling to 100% now.

incident-bot: Action logged: route generation streaming_disabled for 100% at 1718001345.

infra_julian: confirming system metrics: p95 stabilized ~650ms, avg throughput up ~20%. No surge in 5xx. Good so far.

csm_jordan: drafting customer-facing status: "Investigating increased latencies. As an immediate mitigation, we have temporarily disabled streaming responses to stabilize throughput and latency. Customers will receive full responses as single payloads. We expect this to be temporary; updates in 10 minutes."

product-liz: important: ensure function-calling and SDKs handle non-stream fallback gracefully — add note to status.

alex_k: seeing a small number of timeouts for extremely long completions after switching to non-streaming. Proposal: enforce a temporary max_tokens_per_request = 2048 to prevent runaway jobs.

sre_oncall_anna: applying token cap via control plane now.

oncall-next-mia: i'll be taking handoff in ~15m. anything high priority I should watch?

sre_oncall_anna: main things for handoff:
- keep an eye on p95/p99 by region
- active_stream_sessions metric (should be down)
- GPU queue depth and node scale events
- 4xx/5xx rate and app-level 429s due to throttles

sre_oncall_anna: runbook snippet for quick checks:
```text
- Grafana: generation service -> p95/p99 & active_stream_sessions
- k8s: kubectl -n inference get pods -> restart count, CPU/GPU pod pressure
- Control plane: GET /routes/generation -> confirm streaming_enabled:false and quotas
- If re-enable required: PATCH /routes/patch {streaming_enabled:true, pct:10} then observe
```

ops_ben: also monitor the gateway error counts — if we see 502/504 increase after disabling streaming, rollback.

csm_jordan: status posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-032 

sre_oncall_anna: 20m from mitigation: metrics stable, no new customer errors. I recommend keeping streaming disabled until infra can adjust autoscaler and we validate new batching heuristics. Opening postmortem ticket and scheduling a bridge tomorrow for a root cause deep-dive.

product-liz: flagged for postmortem and product impact assessment.

oncall-next-mia: taking over now. thanks @sre_oncall_anna. I'll hold until morning and then coordinate re-enable with infra.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to SEV3 at 1718001400. Mitigation in place.

sre_oncall_anna: closing incident thread here for now — will create postmortem draft and link back. Ping @oncall-next-mia or me directly if anything changes. :thumbsup:
